title: A rainbow partition theorem for trees and connected maximin share allocations of chores
abstract: arXiv:2609.38628v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Xiao, Qiu, and Huang (AAMAS 2023) and independently Lonc (personal communication) asked whether indivisible chores located at the vertices of a tree can always be allocated to $n$ agents in connected bundles so that the cost of every agent is at most its connected maximin share; for goods, this is a theorem of Bouveret, Cechl\'arov\'a, Elkind, Igarashi, and Peters. We answer the question affirmatively, even for monotone costs. The answer follows from a combinatorial theorem: if $\mathcal P_1,\ldots,\mathcal P_k$ are partitions of the vertex set of a finite tree, each into at most $k$ connected parts, then the vertex set can be split into disjoint sets $B_1,\ldots,B_k$, some possibly empty, such that each nonempty $B_i$ is connected and contained in a part of $\mathcal P_i$. Equivalently, if each of $k$ colours occurs on at most $k-1$ edges of a tree, then the vertices can be partitioned into connected sets labelled by distinct colours,

translated_title: 树上的彩虹划分定理与杂务的连通极大极小份额分配
translated_abstract: Xiao、Qiu 和 Huang（AAMAS 2023）以及独立的 Lonc（私人通信）提出了这样一个问题：位于树顶点上的不可分割杂务是否总能以连通捆绑包的形式分配给 $n$ 个智能体，使得每个智能体的成本至多为其连通极大极小份额；对于物品，这是 Bouveret、Cechlárová、Elkind、Igarashi 和 Peters 的一个定理。我们肯定地回答了这个问题，即使对于单调成本也成立。答案源自一个组合定理：如果 $\mathcal P_1,\ldots,\mathcal P_k$ 是有限树顶点集的划分，每个划分至多分成 $k$ 个连通部分，那么顶点集可以被分割成不相交的集合 $B_1,\ldots,B_k$（其中一些可能为空），使得每个非空的 $B_i$ 是连通的且包含在 $\mathcal P_i$ 的某个部分中。等价地，如果 $k$ 种颜色中每一种在树的至多 $k-1$ 条边上出现，那么顶点可以被划分为由不同颜色标记的连通集合。
tldr: 本文证明了一个树上彩虹划分组合定理，并据此肯定地回答了树上的不可分割杂务总能以连通捆绑包方式公平分配给 $n$ 个智能体、使每个智能体成本不超过其连通极大极小份额的问题，且该结论对单调成本同样成立。
en_tdlr: This paper proves a rainbow partition theorem for trees and affirmatively answers whether indivisible chores located on a tree can always be allocated to $n$ agents in connected bundles such that each agent's cost is at most its connected maximin share, even for monotone costs.
